overview_description.description: Letterbook provides an AI-native customer support platform for managing and resolving customer support tickets across email, in-app feedback, and website forms. The platform uses AI to triage incoming tickets, draft and send replies, and update a support knowledge base. Letterbook connects to tools such as inbox providers, customer databases, and Stripe so it can look up orders, subscriptions, and account data while handling requests. Teams define scenarios and instructions for common support cases so the AI can follow their playbook. The platform also offers a contact center interface with shortcuts, a smart knowledge base, and analytics to track resolution time, automation rate, and customer satisfaction.
